verbatim.text: Data users who create their own estimates using data from disseminated tables and other data should cite the Census Bureau as the source of the original data only. Conclusions drawn from any analysis of these data are the sole responsibility of the performing party.

license.how_honoured: County aggregates only, from published tables; the shares (living alone, same-sex couples per 1,000) are the survey's own estimates computed from those tables, credited to the Census Bureau as the source of the original data; the survey claims no endorsement.

gate_history: 2026-11-06: api.census.gov began requiring an API key in the URL and www2.census.gov was not allowed — slot PENDING. 2026-11-15: the maintainer allowed www2.census.gov; the table-based summary files need no key.
method: Householders living alone (B11001_008) ÷ all households (B11001_001), per cent; MOE by the Census ratio formula.
caveats: Five-year pooled survey estimates (2019–2023), not a count; every label carries its 90% margin of error.
Estimates with a coefficient of variation above 30% are labelled unreliable on the map, not hidden.
Households, never people: nobody is identifiable from these figures.

validation.spot_check: 10 random counties (seed 11) re-read from the raw .dat files on 2026-11-15: households, living-alone counts, same-sex couple counts and rates all match (10/10).
